sources.title: Reviews: Alchemy
sources.supports: Independent reader aggregate and mixed reactions to the book's ideas, reasoning, readability, and audiobook delivery.

sources.title: Book review: Alchemy, by Rory Sutherland
sources.supports: Behavioural-economics analysis of the book's theoretical strands, anecdotal method, and loose structure.
sources.limitations: One specialist's reading; not peer-reviewed and not a general consensus.

sources.title: Book Review: Alchemy
sources.supports: Marketing-focused assessment of the book's breadth, entertainment value, and challenge of organising its many briefly treated points.
sources.limitations: One review in a marketing outlet, useful for delivery but not an evidence audit.

sources.title: Alchemy: Summary of Key Ideas and Review
sources.supports: Secondary corroboration of the main themes and broad chapter-level ideas; not used for unique factual claims.
